decisions.reason: Document capture extends the firm's electronic document workflows, and its own R&D can refine the recognition technology, but it sits further from the messaging core and was not seen on the website in 2020 to 2021, which raises the risk of refocusing.
Email and fax conversion draws on long-held channel integration know-how and still serves regulated German customers who rely on fax, so it fits existing capabilities despite its lower visibility.
This feature sits very close to the core fax service and costs little to run, but its low visibility in recent years suggests it may be quietly folded into the base offering.

Multi-engine virus scanning builds directly on the firm's secure messaging expertise and supports its security direction, so the firm can keep operating and improving it with the knowledge it already holds.
